jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer to grow their career at AJ Bell, helping us to develop the future of our services that power Feel Good Investing. You will be joining a cross functional development team which has a philosophy of continuous improvement, and a strong focus on engineering excellence.

This role is part of a growing team focussed on providing the core services that underpin our apps and websites, ensuring our customers are provided with world-class innovative investment solutions and services.

We are on the lookout for an experienced Full Stack Engineer who can help architect, build and deploy apis, web apps, data layers, and 3rd party integrations across the stack, from NodeJS (Typescript), MongoDB, React, and cloud-native solutions in AWS.

**What to expect:**

* Hands-on with full stack feature development, working with other engineers across different disciplines in a dedicated product-aligned squad
* A dynamic, cross-functional Agile squad with a continuous improvement mindset, and autonomy to do the right thing
* Working closely with Product, UX and Business colleagues, as well as mobile and web engineers, to propose new solutions and pilot ideas that help customers Feel Good Investing
* Embrace a ‘build it, run it, own it’ DevOps mentality, nurturing code from idea all the way to production

**Tech Competency**

* 5+ years commercial experience developing web applications and APIs with some of the following; Node (Typescript), React, PHP, .NET core, MongoDB and/or SQL.
* Experience in developing HTTP-based APIs and implementation of RESTful services, as well as GraphQL
* Thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines with experience of Jenkins and/or CodePipeline
* Practices Test Driven Development and is comfortable with various test frameworks and concepts.
* Familiarisation with containerisation and tools like Docker, ECS or Kubernetes
* Experience of developing, deploying, and maintaining Cloud-Based solutions on AWS
* Strong technical background in web development with Javascript frameworks would be ideal
* Understand the principles behind what makes a high performing web page

**Other required skills:**

* Demonstrable experience working with stakeholders from product management and other business areas to design and deliver a solution
* An interest in user experience and an appreciation for helping to solve the problem customers have
* A keen eye for detail and ability to articulate and digest technical and non-technical requirements to others

**About AJ Bell**

AJ Bell is one of the UK’s fastest-growing investment platform businesses, providing award-winning solutions for everyone, from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we’re helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We’re proud to be recognised as one of the UK’s Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026 a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

**What we offer**

* 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
* 6% Pension with matched contributions
* Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
* Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
* Free onsite gym
* Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
* Travel and bike loan schemes Employee Assistance Programme

**Life at AJ Bell**

* Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
* Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
* Casual dress code
* Friendly, supportive team environment

**Our ways of working**

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

**Inclusion & diversity**

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a growing digital solutions company delivering innovative software, automation, and document processing solutions for enterprise clients across multiple sectors. We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our team and help design, develop, and support business-critical applications and integrations.

**The Role**

As a Software Engineer, you will be involved in the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through to development, testing, deployment, and support. You will work closely with technical and business stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions.
* Develop integrations between business applications and third-party systems.
* Create and maintain SQL Server database objects, including stored procedures and views.
* Develop web applications, APIs, and background services.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
* Produce technical documentation and support materials.
* Collaborate across the teams to deliver successful projects.

**Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* Strong experience with C# and .NET development.
* Experience with SQL Server and database design.
* Knowledge of REST APIs and integration technologies.
* Understanding of software engineering principles, including maintainability, scalability, and reliability.
* Experience with source control systems such as Git.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Azure cloud services.
* Experience with JavaScript and modern web frameworks.
* Exposure to workflow or business process automation platforms.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience working in a customer-facing consultancy environment.

**What We Offer**

* Flexible working arrangements.
* Ongoing training and professional development.
* Opportunity to work with leading technologies and enterprise customers.
* Supportive and collaborative team environment.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an excellent opportunity for a software engineer who enjoys solving complex business challenges, working directly with clients, and contributing to innovative solutions that deliver real business value.

**To apply, please send your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and interest in the role.**

Pay: £45,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Why A365 Software Engineering?**

Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Altium 365 for cloud lets design engineers communicate, collaborate and bring their ideas to market more efficiently than any platform in the industry. These are some of the R&D Software Engineering contributions you might make to Altium 365:

* Building new cloud-native applications and scalable infrastructure
* Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
* Large-scale data processing; data modeling; holistic, intent-based API design
* Stateful and stateless servers, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.

**A day in the life of our Senior Software Engineer:**

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary role will be product development for complex cloud applications with the Altium 365 R&D team.

* Work with a tech stack of .NET Core, AWS, multi-tenant architecture, and distributed high-load systems.
* Handle tech challenges different from most others on the market, a mixture of complex engineering software, microelectronics and cloud services
* Add to the team’s expertise through collaboration and sharing knowledge

**The working mode is hybrid: 3 days a week from one of our offices (Katowice or Wroclaw).**

 **Qualifications**

**Required technology experience:**

* .NET Core, .NET Framework.
* Microservices.
* CI, CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes.
* MySQL (FireBird, Oracle as a plus).

**Will be a plus:**

* AWS, EC2, ECS, RDS, etc. - or Azure/GCP
* Multi-tenant architecture
* Sentry, New Relic for alerts and monitoring

  
**Additional Information**

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Ruby on Rails Developer
jobs.description:
**Type**
--------

Full-time

**Location**
------------

Wrocław/remote

**Salary**
----------

15 000 - 20 000 PLN/MONTH [B2B NET]

12 500 - 16 700 GROSS [EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT]

**Employment Type**
-------------------

B2B / EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

**About Momentum:**
-------------------

At Momentum, we accelerate digital innovation in **healthcare**. Our mission is to empower HealthTech startups and scaleups by transforming ideas into cutting-edge digital products. We combine deep industry expertise, strategic consulting, and full-stack development to create solutions that drive growth, compliance, and patient impact.

We work **AI-first**. AI is part of our everyday work, in development and in delivery. We keep testing new tools, agents and workflows, and when we find a better way to build, we change how we work.

But in healthcare, AI output is a starting point, not a final answer. **Verification and ownership stay with us.** We believe in technology that makes healthcare more accessible, efficient, and human-centered.

**Role overview:**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Ruby on Rails Developer to help build robust, scalable web applications for clients around the world, mainly in HealthTech but not only.

You'll write and review code, contribute to architecture decisions, optimize performance and care about code quality, working closely with PMs, designers and other developers. You'll use AI every day to move faster, and you'll be the one who makes sure the code is actually correct, secure and maintainable before it gets merged. "AI generated it" isn't done. In healthcare, a subtle bug or a missed edge case costs more than time.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 5+ years of commercial experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails,
* Strong knowledge of relational database design (e.g. PostgreSQL),
* Ability to implement various ways of communication with the client (e.g. REST API, WebSockets),
* Ability to implement various ways of authentication (e.g. JWT, cookie-based auth, OAuth),
* Experience with CI/CD, deployment tools, Docker and Git,
* Practical knowledge of design patterns and SOLID principles,
* Practical experience in writing and maintaining automated tests using RSpec or similar frameworks,
* Practical knowledge of non-relational databases, caching and message brokers,
* Experience in diagnosing and solving performance and optimization problems,
* Ability to contribute to project architecture based on business, functional and non-functional requirements, with an understanding of scalability concepts,
* Love for code review, both giving and receiving it,
* Willingness to help other developers and share knowledge,
* Using AI tools in your daily work and the ability to critically review AI-generated code before it reaches the codebase,
* Fluent written and spoken English, and confidence in talking directly with clients, e.g. during calls, demos or technical discussions
* Fluent written and spoken Polish, as it's our main language of internal communication,
* Interest in HealthTech and readiness to work on projects where quality, security and compliance really matter.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Knowledge of JavaScript framework like Vue or React
* Experience with AWS or similar platform
* Experience with Web Server (e.g. Nginx)
* Degree in Computer Science or relevant field
* Healthtech or pharmacy experience: HIPAA, e-prescribing, insurance, FHIR.
* You've worked embedded with a client, in consulting, as an FDE or in a startup where you wore several hats.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Designing and building web applications using Ruby on Rails,
* Designing and implementing relational databases,
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design and ship new features,
* Writing automated tests for your code, including edge cases, usability and general reliability,
* Fixing bugs and improving performance,
* Reviewing code, including AI-generated code, with the same standards as any other,
* Helping define and improve internal standards for maintainability and style,
* Using AI tools (e.g. Claude) to speed up development work,
* Communicating directly with clients when needed: clarifying requirements, discussing technical solutions and presenting your work,
* Continuously discovering, testing and implementing new technologies and workflows, and sharing what works with the team.

**This role probably isn't for you if:**
----------------------------------------

* you prefer to treat a ticket as finished once the code runs, rather than when it's tested, reviewed and something you'd be comfortable maintaining a year from now,
* you prefer a stack and workflow that stay the same for years. We regularly test new tools and approaches, and when we find a better way to build, we adopt it,
* you'd rather someone else took responsibility for what gets merged. Here, AI can write a first draft, but you're the one who signs it off.

**What We Value:**
------------------

* Clarity in focus and dedication to building digital products that elevate healthcare and improve quality of life.
* Flair to face challenges with boldness, creativity, and a proactive mindset.
* Grit to take ownership, stay ambitious, and deliver refined, high-quality solutions.
* Impact through meaningful innovation that makes pioneering medical discoveries accessible and human-centered.
* Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and iteration with users.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Modern Workspace: We provide a modern and comfortable office environment, right in the heart of Wrocław.
* Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy **flexible working hours**, allowing you to find the perfect balance between work and life.
* Stay Active: Our company **Multisport** benefit encourages you to stay fit and take care of your well-being.
* Your Health Matters: Access to **private healthcare** ensures you're taken care of when you need it most.
* Remote Support: For our remote team members, we **reimburse office visits**, both required and optional.
* Freedom of choice: We understand that we all have different lifestyles and needs, that's why the **Worksmile Cafeteria System** gives you access to hundreds of non-wage benefits to choose from.
* Security and peace of mind: We provide the option to join our comprehensive **insurance** plan, for your and your loved one's security.
* Team Building & Development Fun(d): We believe in the power of fun and development, and **microfunds** are here to bring some excitement into your work-life or you can access them to develop your skills and gain knowledge.
* AI-powered work: Access to AI tools like Claude and Gemini, plus real influence on how we use AI in development and space to test new tools and workflows.

**Thinking of applying? Awesome! Here’s what happens next:**
------------------------------------------------------------

As a standard, we keep our recruitment processes short and to the point.

* Initial phone interview (20 min): We'll have a quick chat to get to know each other and discuss your experience. It's a great opportunity for us both to see if there's a good fit.
* Recruitment task: Following the interview, we will send you a short task to complete. You will have three working days to complete and return it.
* Technical interview (45-60 min): If your task is successful, you'll be invited to a technical interview. You will meet with a senior team member to dive deeper into your technical knowledge and discuss your solution.
* Meeting with the CTO (15 min): If you successfully pass the previous stages, we will invite you to meet with our CTO. This is a unique chance to hear firsthand about the company's vision, mission, and long-term goals, and to ask questions about the direction we are heading
* ‍Decision and feedback: After all the stages are complete, we'll get back to you with our final decision and detailed feedback on your application.

If you have any questions, get in touch with us!

jobs.title: Senior backend-/fullstackutvikler
jobs.description:
*Omega 365 Consulting er en ledende leverandør av dyktig prosjektpersonell til aktører innen olje, gass, fornybar energi og infrastruktur. Vi tilbyr et bredt utvalg av konsulentoppdrag, inkludert mange av de mest spennende prosjektene i Norge og i utlandet.*

  
  

**Detaljer:**

Varighet: 09.11.2026-30.06.2027, med opsjoner til 30.06.2029
  
Lokasjon: Oslo. Mulighet for hjemmekontor når dette er forenlig med arbeidsoppgavene og samarbeid i teamet.
  
Søknadsfrist: 11.10.2026 kl. 23:59

  
  

**Beskrivelse av oppdraget**

Norsk helsenett (NHN) søker en senior backend-/fullstackutvikler til et tverrfaglig produktteam som utvikler og videreutvikler tjenester på Helsenorge.

Teamet har ansvar for områdene Personvern og sekundærbruk samt Person og tilgang, og arbeider med løsninger der sikkerhet, personvern og korrekt tilgang til helseopplysninger står sentralt.

De siste årene har teamet blant annet utviklet løsninger for fullmakt ved uthenting av medisiner på apotek, samtykke til forskningsprosjekter, persontilpasning på Helsenorge, oversikt over delte helseopplysninger samt tilgangsstyring og personvern knyttet til blant annet helsekort for gravide og pasientens prøvesvar.

  

Konsulenten inngår som senior utvikler i et tverrfaglig utviklingsteam og skal blant annet:

* Utvikle og videreutvikle tjenester og funksjonelle løsningsområder på Helsenorge.
* Bidra til modernisering av eksisterende løsninger og reduksjon av teknisk gjeld.
* Ha hovedvekt på backend-utvikling i .NET/C#.
* Bidra med frontend-utvikling ved behov.
* Delta i hele utviklingsløpet fra spesifisering og løsningsdesign til implementering og testing.
* Bidra til testautomatisering og kontinuerlige leveranser.
* Samarbeide tett med utviklere og andre fagroller i teamet.
* Bidra aktivt til kunnskapsdeling og kontinuerlig forbedring av løsninger og arbeidsprosesser.

  

**Kvalifikasjoner**

Vi ser etter en erfaren senior utvikler med dokumentert kompetanse innen:

* Backend-utvikling
* .NET
* C#
* Databaseteknologi
* Relasjonsdatabaser
* MS SQL Server
* Relevant høyere IT-utdanning
* Norsk på profesjonelt nivå
* Engelsk på profesjonelt nivå

Ønsket kompetanse

Det er en fordel med erfaring innen:

* Frontend-utvikling
* React
* Testautomatisering
* Kontinuerlige leveranser
* Utvikling av sikkerhetskritiske løsninger
* Kodeagenter og moderne AI-støttet programvareutvikling

  

**Bli en del av Omega 365 Consulting for:**

* *Tett og personlig oppfølging fra våre dedikerte Omega 365-teammedlemer*
* *Du får jobbe med et av de mest velrennomerte konsulentselskapene i Norge*
* *Veiledning fra erfarne avdelingsledere som hjelper deg med å bygge god prosjektkompetanse*
* *Konkurransedyktig kompensasjon og forsikringsordninger*
* *Intern VISUM støtte og rådgivning til EØS/ Expats konsulenter*
* *Gode muligheter for å utvide ditt profesjonelle nettverk gjennom prosjektdeltakelse og sosiale arrangementer*
* *Svært attraktivt velferdstilbud med feriehus og hytter på Hovden, Hemsedal, Geilo, Hafjell, Oppdal, Voss, Vågsli, Sirdal, Gran Canaria og Thailand*
* *Bredt utvalg av arrangementer, som konserter og turer til spennende destinasjoner i Norge og utland. Vi annonserer nye attraktive turer til våre ansatte hvert år*

*Utforsk mer på:* *https://omega365.com/advantage*
